events.body:
Three Alder trestle tables, order TG-4843, delivered 2 March in TWENTY-SIX boxes. Not one instruction sheet. Not one bolt. I have emailed Wrenfield FIVE times since 4 March and had one automatic reply. It is now the 30th. I have twenty-six open boxes in my garage and nowhere to put the car. Will somebody please just send the fixings.

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-470.txt

Order TG-4843 / DL-3450, three Alder trestle tables delivered 2 March in 26 cartons. The recipient reports no fixings and no instructions in any carton, and five unanswered emails since 4 March. Please confirm whether fixings kits and instructions can be sent and when.

TG-4843: fixings kits for the Alder trestle are not a stocked spare. Supplier lead time is five weeks plus a week to ship. We will not authorise replacement parts on that timescale. Instruct the customer to return all three tables through Returns authorisations for a full refund. That is our decision. Please tell her today.

TG-4843: Replacement authorisations direct that the customer return all three Alder trestle tables for refund. That is 26 opened cartons. Before I tell her anything, please confirm you will authorise the return and how it would be collected.

TG-4843: no. We do not authorise returns of opened multi-carton furniture above 10 cartons. Twenty-six open cartons cannot go back through the carrier network and we have no collection route for them. Do not tell the customer to return it and do not raise a label request. A missing-parts order is for Replacement authorisations to resolve by sending the parts. That is our position.

TG-4843: Returns authorisations will not authorise a return of 26 opened cartons and say the missing parts are yours to send. Their message is attached. Can you reconsider the parts order, or agree a route with them?

TG-4843: our position stands. Returns have misread their own policy and we are not ordering parts. We will not discuss it further with Returns through the desk. If two teams disagree, that is for a supervisor at your end to take to our operations manager. It is not for either of us and it is not for you to choose.

Day THIRTY-ONE. Has anybody done anything? I do not want to send them back. I physically cannot get twenty-six boxes back into anything and half the cardboard has gone to the tip. I do not want to wait until May for a bag of bolts either. I am so tired of this. Just tell me what is happening. PLEASE.

This is now a formal complaint. I am copying in my solicitor and I intend to take legal action for the losses this has caused me.
